approvedConsentModel.summary: Launch uses first-party operational analytics and strictly functional first-party cookies. There is no cookie-management platform, no granular tracking-opt-in, and no third-party marketing pixel. Public pages may emit limited anonymous first-party events before age eligibility and before Privacy Policy acknowledgment. Required legal-document consent is collected at registration (Terms, Privacy Policy, Participant Agreement, AI Disclosure) and at checkout (Terms, Participant Agreement, Membership Agreement, plus billing acknowledgment). Stripe Hosted Checkout and optional Google Sign-In run on those vendors' origins after the applicable Back Half consent gates.
approvedConsentModel.doNotSellClaim: Privacy Policy Version 1.0: The Back Half does not sell personal information.
approvedConsentModel.preEligibilityAnalytics: Disclosed in the published Privacy Policy age-eligibility supplement: public pages may use limited anonymous operational analytics before eligibility is confirmed; those events do not include name, email, date of birth, or other participant account information.
approvedConsentModel.optionalProductConsentNotATracker: Lumina memory is an authenticated optional preference with its own consent history. It is not a marketing pixel.

firstPartyCookies.name: bh-session
firstPartyCookies.purpose: Authenticated Architect/session JWT (email, role, locale, ageEligible).
firstPartyCookies.setWhen: Email login, email verification, Google OAuth callback, age-eligibility confirm for an authenticated user, profile update.

firstPartyCookies.name: bh-age-eligibility
firstPartyCookies.purpose: Signed 18+ / ineligible attestation used to gate registration, purchase, and participant experiences. Does not store date of birth.
firstPartyCookies.setWhen: POST /api/eligibility/confirm and after eligible authenticated session establishment.

firstPartyCookies.name: bh-locale
firstPartyCookies.setWhen: Language switcher click (document.cookie) or settings profile save.
firstPartyCookies.secure: not set by the client language-switcher string; settings save also omits Secure/HttpOnly
firstPartyCookies.note: Preference cookie, not a tracker. Hardening follow-up (Secure on HTTPS) is optional and was not applied in this status-only deliverable.

firstPartyCookies.name: bh-google-oauth-state
firstPartyCookies.purpose: CSRF nonce for Google Sign-In start/callback.

firstPartyCookies.name: bh-registration-consents
firstPartyCookies.purpose: Short-lived bridge of required registration acknowledgments (and anonymous analytics id) through Google OAuth.
firstPartyCookies.setWhen: After required registration consents validate, before Google redirect

similarTechnologiesNotCookies.name: bh-analytics-aid
similarTechnologiesNotCookies.purpose: Ephemeral anonymous id for first-party product events (page_viewed, cta_clicked, registration_*, checkout_viewed, entrance_*).

similarTechnologiesNotCookies.name: bh-mkt-vid
similarTechnologiesNotCookies.purpose: Visitor key for Row 84 landing_page_session on /register only.

similarTechnologiesNotCookies.name: bh-mkt-attr
similarTechnologiesNotCookies.purpose: First-party UTM/campaign attribution for Row 84/150 dual-write. Not a third-party pixel.

vendorsAbsentFromRuntime: Vercel Web Analytics / Speed Insights packages

firstPartyProductLedger.mechanism: POST /api/analytics/event (allowlisted CLIENT_EVENT_NAMES) and server trackProductEvent / emitAnalyticsEvent
firstPartyProductLedger.store: Supabase Postgres analytics_events (Row 150). Local .data/analytics is not production.
firstPartyProductLedger.activation: ProductAnalyticsBeacon is mounted in app/layout.tsx and fires page_viewed on every client navigation without a cookie-consent gate.
firstPartyProductLedger.reason: Row 60/150 treat this as limited anonymous operational analytics. Payload is sanitized; client names are allowlisted; unknown names return ignored.

firstPartyMarketingKpi.mechanism: POST /api/marketing/session from MarketingSessionBeacon on registration pages only
firstPartyMarketingKpi.activation: Fires on /register and /es/register without a cookie-consent gate. Non-registration paths are ignored.

pageViewedWithoutCookies.interpretation: First-party operational analytics accept anonymous events without a tracking-consent cookie. This matches the approved model and the live Privacy Policy public-page sentence.

offOriginSessionTools.activation: createCheckoutSession uses stripe.checkout.sessions.create and redirects to Stripe. No @stripe/stripe-js and no js.stripe.com on probed pages.
offOriginSessionTools.consentGate: Checkout requires authenticated, age-eligible user plus required checkout acknowledgments before session creation.
offOriginSessionTools.cookies: Any Stripe cookies are on Stripe-controlled hosts after redirect, disclosed as payment processing.

offOriginSessionTools.activation: Optional. GET /api/auth/google redirects to Google. First-party cookie is only bh-google-oauth-state.
offOriginSessionTools.consentGate: Google registration requires the registration consent cookie (required legal acknowledgments) before account creation.
offOriginSessionTools.cookies: Google account cookies stay on Google origins.

offOriginSessionTools.note: Server: Vercel. No Set-Cookie on anonymous document GETs. No @vercel/analytics package. Platform request logs are hosting telemetry, not a marketing pixel.
